entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Of course. The name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF886-01. It's for the Apex Pro cycling shoes.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. You received them about seven days ago. To process this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a fit preference?

It's a fit issue. I've taken them on two rides, and they're just not working for me. I keep getting painful blisters on my heels, which has never happened with other shoes. I've adjusted the cleats multiple times, but the fit itself seems to be the problem.

I'm sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort; getting blisters is definitely not what we want for our customers. Since it's a fit issue and you're well within our 90-day policy for apparel, I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

Okay, a full refund sounds good. I appreciate that. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of packaging these up and I've lost a week of training time trying to make them work, is there anything else you can do for me? Perhaps a discount on a different pair of shoes?

I understand your position. While I can't offer a direct discount on a future item as part of the return, I do see you're one of our VIP members, Alex. As a thank you for your loyalty and to help you get into a better-fitting pair of shoes, I can add a 20% off coupon to your account that will be valid for your next purchase. Would that work for you?
A 20% coupon, you say? Yes, that would be very helpful. Thank you, Isaac, I appreciate you doing that. That's a fair solution.

You're very welcome. I've just emailed you the pre-paid return label. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. The 20% coupon has already been applied to your VeloFit account. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to help, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
